ITEM.PTXT: By pressing the "Menu" panel switch, the screen changes to the menu screen, where each function can be selected. Note that some functions cannot be operated while driving.

ENTRY.PTXT: Stop Guidance/Resume Guidance, Volume Settings, VICS, Congestion Prediction, Memory Points, User Customize, Settings, Disconnect, Data in Use

ITEM.PTXT: The route being guided can be deleted to stop route guidance. Also, after guidance is stopped, the display changes to "Resume Guidance", and guidance can be resumed by touching it.
Voice guidance ON/OFF, volume adjustment and automatic volume switching at high speed can be set.
The screen changes to the VICS menu screen, where VICS information display settings can be made.
Based on congestion prediction information obtained from the G-BOOK center, congestion prediction marks are displayed on the route.
Memory points (including home and special memory points) and detour memory points can be registered, modified and deleted, and the destination history can be deleted.

ENTRY.PTXT: Registration of Memory Points (Including Home and Special Memory Points)

Points specified on the map screen can be registered as 400 memory points (including 1 home and 5 special memory points), 100 G-memory points and 10 detour memory points. The registered home is displayed with a mark. Also, when memory points are displayed, the name can be changed and a symbol can be set.
Modification of Memory Points (Including Home and Special Memory Points)
The position, telephone number, name and symbol of registered memory points (including 1 home and 5 special memory points) and detour memory points can be modified.
Deletion of Memory Points (Including Home and Special Memory Points)
Registered memory points (including 1 home and 5 special memory points) and detour memory points can be deleted.

ITEM.PTXT: Up to 3 patterns of navigation settings, such as display settings, can be stored. By recalling these navigation settings, the system can be smoothly adapted when the purpose of use or the user changes.

TABLE.TITLE: Setting Items That Can Be Stored (Example)

ENTRY.PTXT: Map orientation setting, map display mode setting, map display scale setting, right screen setting for 2 screen, volume setting, automatic maintenance notification setting, menu screen setting items, VICS map display setting, VICS road display content setting, VICS interrupt setting, ETC setting

ITEM.PTXT: Vehicles with factory-option ETC system with navigation link function.
Settings for each item can be made on the navigation screen.
Data communication with the G-BOOK center is disconnected.
Information such as the database stored on the hard disk in use is displayed.

NAVI AI-SHIFT has been adopted, which selects the appropriate gear according to the road shape and road gradient, obtained by combining road corner information from the navigation computer with road gradient information calculated by the engine control computer, and according to vehicle information from the vehicle. For details, refer to the Chassis section.
